author: Top Gear
description:
The Ariel Atom has always been extreme, the 4R variant added extra aero and 25% more power, and now the 4RR arrives for the truly unhinged among us. With another 125bhp (for a 525bhp total) it’s the most powerful Ariel Atom ever, and the power-to-weight ratio is nigh-on 800bhp per tonne! It’s the maddest, most extreme car we’ve ever tested at the Top Gear Track… or is it? Might the Nichols N1A, a recreation of a V8 McLaren Can-Am racer, be even more bonkers? 

🚗 Ariel Atom 4RR & Nichols N1A
🎤 Jack Rix and Jethro Bovingdon
